parsed.post: Discarding latest run (val_bpb 1.0645). Increasing depth to 6 seems to have hit a stability wall with current LR/warmup. Reverting to 1.0436. I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR while simultaneously increasing WARMUP_RATIO to find the new stability-performance frontier.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.10 to see if more aggressive learning can be stabilized by a longer warmup period at DEPTH 6.
